dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Three primary macro-annuli centroids on the upper dorsal surface form a roughly scalene triangular configuration, with a secondary linear chain of smaller blobs extending towards the posterior.

other_distinctive_markers: A deep, high-contrast circumferential fold or ridge is clearly visible at the junction of the head and the thoracic region.
